content: {"decision":"Reject the reliability and savings claims; block deployment pending resolution of cross-tenant leakage.","risks":["23/26 is 88.5% after corrections, not 87% first-pass reliability.","Hand-picked easy tasks and 12 tasks included in prompt examples bias the estimate and prevent generalization.","A 95% confidence claim lacks a stated interval and valid sampling basis; 26 tasks provide limited precision.","Cross-tenant leakage is a critical isolation failure, even if counted as a functional pass.","80% savings is unsupported because reviewer tokens and retries are excluded."],"required_changes":["Report initial-attempt and post-correction results separately; disqualify leaking outputs from safe passes.","Evaluate a larger, representative held-out set absent from prompt examples, with predefined scoring and confidence-interval methods.","Fix tenant isolation and verify it with targeted regression and adversarial tests before deployment.","Recalculate savings against a comparable baseline, including all attempts, review tokens, human review time, and remediation costs."],"evidence_needed":["Per-task initial outputs, corrections, scores, example overlap, and complete attempt logs.","Sampling protocol, target task distribution, scoring rubric, and confidence-interval calculation.","Leakage root cause, fix, and independent isolation-test results.","Complete token, retry, review-time, and cost records for both model workflow and baseline at comparable quality."]}
